defects: All three boards repeatedly concatenated growing prefixes; junior also concatenated every repetition.

Counts, literal whitespace/Unicode, input/output limits and nesting were underspecified.
rationale: Replace all three decoder boards with chunk collectors: iterative saved parent arrays, a recursive indexed group reader and frame objects. Each body joins once, repeats once, then becomes one parent chunk. State O(n+L) total time/storage, explicitly relying on the fixed depth cap; unbounded depth adds a factor. Add a visible literal-space case and three hidden assertions:1555 concatenated known encoded/decoded chunk combinations,64-deep literal/empty1000x groups with Unicode/lone surrogates, and maximum input/output/empty-group cases. Independent length-annotated AST/iterative emitter prunes empty subtrees and passes. Whitespace stripping passed old tests and now fails.
